boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Loras study environments, from library support spaces and technology-equipped lounges to resident common rooms and a specialized science laboratory.

cards.title: Settle In With the Collection Nearby
cards.subtitle: Inside the Miller Academic Resource Center
cards.notes: Bring a research-heavy assignment and ask a librarian for individual help before spreading out near the library collection.
cards.short_summary: A library workspace suited to source-based reading, research, and drafting.
cards.evidence_claim: Loras describes its library as supporting learning and academic success through an extensive collection and individual research assistance.
cards.access_notes: Library checkout requires a Loras student ID; confirm current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Build a Study Session Around Academic Support
cards.subtitle: A support-focused space within the Loras College Library
cards.notes: Start here when a work block may benefit from tutoring, academic coaching, or a quick referral to another campus resource.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative academic-support setting for strengthening coursework and study habits.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons coordinates services intended to expand student learning, including study-skills and time-management support.
cards.source_title: Academic Resources | Student Success | Loras College
cards.access_notes: Academic services are intended for Loras students; consult the current service schedule before planning a supported session.

cards.title: Give a Draft Focused Attention
cards.subtitle: One-on-one writing support in the library’s Learning Commons
cards.notes: Arrive with the assignment prompt and a working draft so a trained tutor can focus the session on your next revision step.
cards.short_summary: A tutor-supported workspace for moving a writing project from ideas to polished prose.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center is located in the library’s Learning Commons and provides one-on-one sessions with trained tutors at every writing stage.
cards.source_title: Academic Resources | Student Success | Loras College
cards.access_notes: Tutor availability varies; check the current Writing Center process or schedule before arriving.

cards.title: Work Through the Sticking Point
cards.subtitle: Drop-in mathematics help in the Learning Commons
cards.notes: Bring the exact problem or concept blocking your progress, then use the drop-in format to get targeted faculty guidance.
cards.short_summary: A mathematics-focused study setting where questions can be addressed as they arise.
cards.evidence_claim: Loras mathematics faculty provide drop-in assistance in the Learning Commons for any student with math-related questions.
cards.source_title: Academic Resources | Student Success | Loras College
cards.access_notes: Open to all Loras students regardless of current math-course enrollment; attend during posted Math Lab availability.

cards.title: Pair Laptop Work With On-Site Printing
cards.subtitle: A technology-equipped lounge in the Alumni Campus Center
cards.notes: Use this lounge when an assignment needs both screen time and a printed copy; review the document before using print credit.
cards.short_summary: A campus-center lounge with printing support for practical assignment prep.
cards.evidence_claim: The current student handbook identifies a student lounge in the Alumni Campus Center with color and black-and-white printing.
cards.access_notes: Campus facilities follow building schedules; printing is subject to the college’s student printing provisions.

cards.title: Choose a Workstation Near Printing
cards.subtitle: The IRC in Hoffmann Hall
cards.notes: Head here for a task that benefits from campus printing, and save the file in a ready-to-print format before you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A named academic-building resource space supporting computer-based coursework and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2025–26 student handbook lists the Instructional Resource Center in Hoffmann Hall among campus public-printing locations.
cards.access_notes: Academic buildings are secured on schedules, and access outside business hours is limited to authorized people.

cards.title: Use a Renovated Resident Gathering Space
cards.subtitle: Shared indoor space in Beckman Hall
cards.notes: Residents can bring a compact study kit to a common area and keep pathways and shared seating clear for hallmates.
cards.short_summary: Renovated shared space offering Beckman residents an alternative to studying in their rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Loras reports that Beckman Hall’s renovation added gathering spaces and improved the residence hall’s common areas.
cards.source_title: Beckman Hall Sees Improvements for Residents
cards.access_notes: This is a residential space; entry requires resident access or an authorized visit following Residence Life rules.

cards.title: Spread Out for an Apartment Study Block
cards.subtitle: A furnished shared room in each Byrne Oaks unit
cards.notes: Residents can use the shared chairs and dining area for group review while coordinating noise and table use with housemates.
cards.short_summary: An apartment living room with seating and a dining surface for resident study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Each Byrne Oaks unit houses six students and includes a shared living room furnished with couches, chairs, and a dining area.
cards.source_title: Campus Housing and Residence | Life at Loras
cards.access_notes: Restricted to assigned residents and their authorized guests; Byrne Oaks eligibility requires 30 credits and a 2.0 GPA.

cards.title: Gather a Four-Person Review Session
cards.subtitle: Shared living space within a Lynch McCarthy apartment
cards.notes: Residents can set up a small review session here, using the provided seating while respecting shared-apartment agreements.
cards.short_summary: A furnished apartment common room sized for a resident group’s collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Lynch McCarthy apartments house groups of four and provide each unit with a shared living room, couches, chairs, and a kitchen set.
cards.source_title: Campus Housing and Residence | Life at Loras
cards.access_notes: Restricted to assigned residents and authorized guests; residents need 50 credits and at least a 2.0 GPA for housing eligibility.

cards.title: Take Science Work Beyond the Textbook
cards.subtitle: A specialized Loras chemistry and biochemistry laboratory
cards.notes: Use this specialized setting only through an assigned course or approved research activity, following faculty lab procedures.
cards.short_summary: A discipline-specific laboratory for supervised experimental learning and research.
cards.evidence_claim: Loras states that its students have access to the named Medical Associates Recombinant DNA Laboratory for chemistry-related study and research.
cards.source_title: Chemistry Major | Bachelor of Science | Loras College
cards.access_notes: Laboratory access is specialized and should be arranged through the relevant course, faculty member, or approved research activity.
